Text.WarriorsDes: Warriors are a class of great strength and vitality. They are not easily killed in battle and have the advantage of being able to use a variety of heavy weapons and Armour. Therefore, Warriors favor attacks that are based on melee physical damage. They are weak in ranged attacks, however the variety of equipment that are developed specifically for Warriors complement their weakness in ranged combat.
Text.WizardDes: Wizards are a class of low strength and stamina, but have the ability to use powerful spells. Their offensive spells are very effective, but because it takes time to cast these spells, they're likely to leave themselves open for enemy's attacks. Therefore, the physically weak wizards must aim to attack their enemies from a safe distance.
Text.TaoistDes: Taoists are well disciplined in the study of Astronomy, Medicine, and others aside from Mu-Gong. Rather then directly engaging the enemies, their specialty lies in assisting their allies with support. Taoists can summon powerful creatures and have a high resistance to magic, and is a class with well balanced offensive and defensive abilities.
Text.AssassinDes: Assassins are members of a secret organization and their history is relatively unknown. They're capable of hiding themselves and performing attacks while being unseen by others, which naturally makes them excellent at making fast kills. It is necessary for them to avoid being in battles with multiple enemies due to their weak vitality and strength.
Text.ArcherDes: Archers are a class of great accuracy and strength, using their powerful skills with bows to deal extraordinary damage from range. Much like wizards, they rely on their keen instincts to dodge oncoming attacks as they tend to leave themselves open to frontal attacks. However, their physical prowess and deadly aim allows them to instil fear into anyone they hit.

Text.ModernWinHelpWelcomeSum: Pick a topic on the left, search above, or start with the basics below. ← → turn the pages of a topic.
Text.ModernWinHelpShortcutsSum: Every key the game listens to, read from your current key bindings.
Text.ModernWinHelpChatSum: Prefixes that send a message to a whisper, your group, your guild or everyone nearby, and @commands.
Text.ModernWinHelpMovementsSum: Left-click the ground to walk, right-click to run; hold the button to keep moving.
Text.ModernWinHelpAttackingSum: Click a monster to attack it. Hold Shift to attack on the spot without stepping.
Text.ModernWinHelpCollectingSum: Stand on an item and press {0} to pick it up; it goes into your bag.
Text.ModernWinHelpHealthSum: The red bar is your HP. Drink potions from the belt ({0} to {1}) before it runs out.
Text.ModernWinHelpSkillsSum: Learn skills from books, put them on the skill bar ({0} to {1}) and train them by using them.
Text.ModernWinHelpManaSum: The blue bar is your MP. Spells cost it; it comes back over time and with potions.
Text.ModernWinHelpStatisticsSum: What AC, MAC, DC, MC, SC, Accuracy, Agility and the rest do for you.
Text.ModernWinHelpChattingSum: Type in the chat box and press Enter. Prefixes pick who hears it.
Text.ModernWinHelpGroupsSum: Invite players with the group window; members nearby share EXP.
Text.ModernWinHelpTradingSum: Face a player and press {0} to ask for a trade; nothing moves until both of you confirm.
Text.ModernWinHelpInspectingSum: Ctrl + right-click a player to see what they are wearing.
Text.ModernWinHelpPurchasingSum: Speak to a merchant NPC and pick Buy to see what they sell.
Text.ModernWinHelpSellingSum: Speak to a merchant NPC to sell items; each merchant deals in its own kind of goods.
Text.ModernWinHelpRepairingSum: Speak to a merchant NPC to repair worn gear for gold; special repair keeps the maximum durability.
Text.ModernWinHelpDurabilitySum: Gear wears down as you fight. At zero it stops working until it is repaired.
Text.ModernWinHelpGemsSum: Put a gem or orb on an item to add to its stats. It can fail.
Text.ModernWinHelpAwakeningSum: Raise an item past its normal limits with materials, at the awakening NPC.
Text.ModernWinHelpQuestsSum: NPCs with quests show a mark over their head. Track up to five on screen.
Text.ModernWinHelpMountsSum: Equip a mount and press {0} to ride. Keep its loyalty up and fit it with gear.
Text.ModernWinHelpFishingSum: With a rod, face the water and cast; reel in when the float dips.
Text.ModernWinHelpHeroesSum: A companion who fights beside you, with its own gear, bag, skills and behaviour.
Text.ModernWinHelpGuildBuffsSum: Guilds spend buff points to give every member a boost.
Text.ModernWinHelpTip1: Hold Shift while you attack to stay on the spot instead of walking into the monster.
